stories.title: North Slope man found dead after house fire
stories.summary: Firefighters found Burton Ahkiviana dead while battling the fire in Nuiqsut on Saturday, Alaska State Troopers said.

stories.title: Anchorage Assembly will debate contentious housing density zoning changes. Here’s what to know.
stories.summary: Mayor Suzanne LaFrance and her administration have not taken a formal stance on the pro-housing policy.

stories.title: The Thanksgiving turkey’s winding road to the center of the holiday’s feast
stories.summary: The idea of a Thanksgiving feast with turkey at its center was truly cemented in the 19th century by Sarah Josepha Hale, a New Hampshire-born writer and author of “Mary Had a Little Lamb.”

stories.title: Small U.S. trucking firms are scrambling to survive mounting diesel costs
stories.summary: Large trucking companies often buy diesel at negotiated discounts and have bigger reserves to cover unanticipated costs. Many smaller operators negotiate a single price for each load and must absorb higher costs.

stories.title: Trump gives the Medal of Freedom to former New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani
stories.summary: After leading New York through Sept. 11, the former mayor’s public life has undergone a rise and fall in recent years.

stories.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, who fought his mistaken deportation, is voluntarily leaving the U.S. for Spain
stories.summary: The Salvadoran migrant was illegally deported to his home country, then brought back to the U.S. and threatened with deportation to African countries.

stories.title: Democrats pick up another seat to clinch the largest House majority since 1990
stories.summary: The 259-seat tally was reached Tuesday after Democrat Victoria Broderick defeated a Republican congressman in Tennessee.

stories.title: Myles Garrett, Micah Parsons ready for spotlight when Rams host Packers on Thanksgiving Eve
stories.summary: If anybody still doubted whether Parsons plans to make his season debut at SoFi Stadium, Garrett inadvertently eased their minds when he was asked about the pregame communication between two superstars who have become friends.

stories.title: Sen. Dan Sullivan concedes Alaska’s U.S. Senate race to Mary Peltola
stories.summary: Peltola, the first Alaska Native set to serve in the Senate, is slated to be sworn in early in January.

stories.title: Alaska ends controversial deal to share voter data with Justice Department
stories.summary: Lt. Gov. Nancy Dahlstrom announced her decision to terminate the agreement two weeks before she is set to leave office.

stories.title: Division of Elections certifies Alaska election results
stories.summary: The certification officially verifies Democrat Mary Peltola’s win over incumbent Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan.

stories.title: Peltola hires Alaskan with White House experience to lead her Senate staff
stories.summary: Sen.-elect Mary Peltola chose Raina Thiele as her chief of staff.
